ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the 19th day of December, 2005, by and between WEST 58th STREET REALTY CORP. ("Owner"), a New York corporation, having an address at c/o RoeCo LLC, 46 Westchester Ave., Pound Ridge, New York 10576, and WESTWARD 58 c/o Alchemy Properties, Inc., 200 Madison Avenue, 20th Floor, New York, New York 10016. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located at Block 1067, Lot 55,on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and as and by the street address 454 West 58" Street, New York, New York, as more particularly described on Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land, the “Owner Land"; the building located thereon is referred to as the “Owner Building"'; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein referred to collectively as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and York, known as Lot 57 in Block 1067 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 462 West 58th Street, New York,NewYork, and more particularly described WHEREAS,Developer intends to construct a new building on the Developer Land, and to construct other improvements associated with such new building (the new building, together with any additions thereto or future alterations thereto or replacements,repairs or rebuilding thereof not prohibited by the provisions of this Agreement, are herein collectively referred to as the “Developer Building"; and the Developer Land and the Developer Building are herein collectively referred to as the“Developer Parcel"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined),than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the DeveloperParcel; WHEREAS,it is contemplated that the Developer Building will contain more floor area than is now available for use on the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for the Merged Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) so as to make maintenance of the Developer Building, and Owner is willing to make such Excess Development Rights available toDeveloper in perpetuity; 2 KL3:2468436.8

WHEREAS,the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing (i) a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term “zoning lot" in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoninglot of the OwnerParcel and theDeveloperParcel(such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged in accordance with the Declaration and the terms of this Agreement, is herein referred to as the “Merged Zoning Lot"), and (i) such other agreements, the Excess Development Rights (the Declaration and such other agreements, easements and licenses are herein collectively referred to as the“Zoning Documents"); WHEREAS,Developer desires to construct the Developer Building so that certain portions of the Developer Building will be cantilevered over the Owner Parcel,and Owner is willing to provide Developer with certain rights and easements in order to construct such cantilevered portion of the Developer Building; WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Merged Zoning Lot and other matters; NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein,and for other good andvaluable consideration,the receipt and sufficiency of follows: 1. Certain Definitions.As used herein: (a)“Additional Development Rights” shall mean any additional Development Rights that may become available to the DeveloperParcel or theMerged Zoning Lot (either by expansion of the Merged Zoning Lot by adding Additional Parcels (as hereinafter defined), by special permit, variance, or by any other procedure or transfer allowed under the provisions of the Zoning Resolution, including, without limitation, 23-90etseq.thereof). (b)“Cantilever" shall mean that portion of Developer Building that is constructed, reconstructed, rebuilt, replaced or located within the Cantilever Encroachment. (c)“Cantilever Encroachment" shall mean that certain volume of space located on the Owner Parcel and more particularly defined in Section 2(r) hereof. (d) “City Agencies" shall mean all agencies of the City of New York whose approval, consent or review may be necessary for the performance of any of the actions contemplated herein,including but not limited to the New York City Department of Buildings, the New York City Department of City Planning, the New York City Planning Commission, the City Council of the City of New York, and any successor entity to any of the foregoing. 3 KL3:2468436.8
